name: After Effects Track-Matte Texture Cutout
use_when: A portrait, icon, product, or cutout image needs a premium texture without losing its visible silhouette.
Dots, grids, noise, or texture should apply only inside an image/cutout.
The animation needs a stylized expert/asset intro while preserving the original image.
avoid_when: The texture makes the face, logo, product, or proof harder to recognize.
The asset has weak edges and the matte would reveal artifacts.
A simple drop shadow or color correction would be clearer.

timeline_pattern.pattern: import_cutout -> duplicate_cutout -> place_texture_above_duplicate -> track_matte_texture_to_duplicate -> keep_original_visible -> parent_duplicate_if_needed -> trim_to_segment
timeline_pattern.duplicate_rule: Duplicate the cutout before matting so the original image remains visible under the texture.
timeline_pattern.parenting_rule: If the cutout slides or scales, ensure texture and duplicate follow the intended parent without creating offset drift.
timeline_pattern.trim_rule: Trim texture, duplicate, and source layer to the same segment range.

motion.rule: Texture should follow the asset motion when the asset moves, unless a stationary texture is intentionally used.

sound.rule: No required SFX; add sound only if the textured asset entrance is a clear visual beat.

captions.rule: Textured cutouts should not sit behind or under captions in a way that reduces caption contrast.

color.rule: Texture color and opacity should support the brand palette and preserve recognition of the underlying subject.

implementation.ffmpeg: Use alpha masks or overlay textures clipped by a matte; preview edges carefully because ffmpeg matte setup is less interactive.
implementation.remotion: Layer the original image, then a duplicate masked texture layer using CSS masks/canvas alpha or preprocessed alpha assets.
implementation.blender: Use image texture masks or alpha planes to apply texture only inside the cutout silhouette.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Duplicate the cutout, use mask/blend/overlay texture if available, and keep a clean original layer visible underneath.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use After Effects track matte workflow or Premiere track matte/keying for simple cases: original image below, duplicate/matte layer, texture clipped to duplicate.

common_mistakes: Track-matting the only copy of the cutout and making the subject transparent.
Parenting the texture incorrectly so it slides away from the asset.
Using a texture that fights the brand style.
Letting texture hide facial features, logos, or proof.
Leaving texture layers longer than the asset segment.
qc: The original cutout remains recognizable under the texture.
Texture stays aligned with the intended asset motion.
Edges do not show obvious matte artifacts.
Captions and text remain readable over or near the textured asset.
Texture, duplicate, and original layers start and end on the intended segment.
